name: Programming Languages
blurb: Python, Rust, C++, Mojo, and Julia in AI work.

languages.name: C++
languages.ai_role: The performance layer underneath the Python surface: PyTorch's libtorch, TensorFlow's core, CUDA kernels, llama.cpp, and most inference runtimes are C++.
languages.steward: ISO/IEC JTC1 SC22 WG21 standards committee
languages.verify_note: The publisher blocks automated checks, so this link is confirmed by hand rather than daily.

languages.name: Go
languages.ai_role: The language of AI plumbing: Ollama, container and orchestration tooling, and many API gateways and agents-infrastructure services ship in Go.
languages.steward: Google and the Go open-source project

languages.name: Julia
languages.ai_role: Scientific computing and differentiable programming: SciML, Flux.jl, and research workloads where numeric performance and expressiveness meet.

languages.name: Mojo
languages.ai_role: A Python-superset systems language built for AI kernels and portable GPU programming; young but aimed squarely at the ML performance gap.

languages.name: Python
languages.ai_role: The default interface of modern AI: PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, Hugging Face Transformers, and nearly every model API SDK lead with Python.

languages.name: Rust
languages.ai_role: The systems language AI infrastructure is migrating toward: Hugging Face tokenizers and candle, vector databases like Qdrant, and a growing share of serving stacks.

languages.name: TypeScript
languages.ai_role: The application layer: official OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs, Vercel's AI SDK, LangChain.js, and most AI product front ends run on TypeScript.
